items.title: HA Body Hydrator Mini
items.body: Our lightweight and fast-absorbing hyaluronic acid body serum hydrates for softer, smoother, and plumper-looking skin. The phyto-collagen complex is known to help visibly firm and boost skin elasticity while a replenishing blend of sodium hyaluronate, red algae, and magnesium chloride improve the skin's moisture barrier.

items.title: The Renewal Duo
items.body: Reveal smooth, even-toned, healthy-looking skin with this targeted bodycare duo. The Glycolic Renewal 10% Glycolic Acid Exfoliating Body Spray helps visibly smooth rough texture, and improve the look of uneven skin tone. Alternate usage with Retinol Revive Overnight Body Lotion.

items.title: Glycolic Acid Exfoliating Spray
items.body: This exfoliating body spray is your shortcut to full-body renewal. Formulated with a powerful blend of 10% glycolic acid and a biomimetic tripeptide to exfoliate dead surface skin, rainbow algae to help refine uneven tone and texture, and licorice root and kakadu plum extracts to help brighten.

items.title: Coral Coast - Body Butter 2pck
items.body: Our nourishing body butter is formulated with a multi-lipid blend of ceramides, essential fatty acids, phospholipids and phytosterols that replenish dry skin. Coconut and sea buckthorn oils lock in moisture for a healthier looking skin barrier.

items.title: Fragrance Free - Travel Size Body Wash
items.body: Our gentle yet effective fragrance free travel size body wash is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Made with a nourishing blend of coconut water and our fermented oil complex that moisturize and soften while hyaluronic acid, niacinamide and sodium PCA balance, replenish and soothe.

items.title: Seascape - Summer Reset Bundle
items.body: Two full-size Seascape fan-favorites plus a fragrance-free acne body treatment. Includes Serum Body Wash, AHA Serum Deodorant, and Salicylic Acid Body Treatment - a routine that cleanses, nourishes, and refreshes from head to toe.

items.title: Santal Bloom - Body Scrub
items.body: This oil-infused body scrub gently exfoliates and revives dull skin with ultra-refined salt and sugar crystals. Vitamin C oil helps to visibly brighten the look of skin and boost glow, while moringa, rosehip, jojoba, and kukui oils help replenish moisture.

items.title: Hydrate & Glow Duo
items.body: Our bestselling HA Body Hydrator Hyaluronic Acid Body Serum (sold out 7x for a reason) delivers instant hydration, formulated with sodium hyaluronate, a phyto-collagen complex, and red algae for added skin barrier support. The Vitamin C Body Brightener Glow Complex Serum helps improve radiance.

items.title: Shea Soleil - Body Mist
items.body: A lightweight fragrance mist that layers effortlessly, Shea Soleil is like warm sunlight lingering close to the skin. Wear alone or layer with body wash and/or lotion to increase the longevity of your fragrance.

items.title: Coral Coast - Shimmering Body Oil
items.body: Formulated with a skin-loving blend of oils including fermented saururus, kukui, cacay and squalane, along with a biomimetic blend of plant actives that absorb easily to soften skin. Added pink pearl pigments provide a sunkissed glow.

items.title: Shea Soleil - Body Oil
items.body: Our nourishing Shea Soleil body oil is formulated with a replenishing blend of oils including fermented saururus, kukui, cacay, moringa and squalane along with a biomimetic blend of plant actives and astaxanthin that absorb easily and leave skin dewy and glowing.

items.title: Shea Soleil - Body Butter
items.body: Our nourishing body butter is formulated with a multi-lipid blend of ceramides, essential fatty acids, phospholipids and phytosterols that restore dry skin. Coconut and sea buckthorn oils lock in moisture for a healthier looking skin barrier.

items.title: Shea Soleil - Body Wash
items.body: This silky cream body cleanser is formulated with shea butter, glycerin, and coconut-derived surfactants to thoroughly cleanse the body as it transforms into a satisfying lather. Skin is left soft, nourished and moisturized.

items.title: Vitamin C Body Serum
items.body: This lightweight and fast-absorbing Vitamin C body serum treatment boosts glow, brightens tone and revitalizes dull, lackluster skin. Formulated with our Glow Complex featuring multiple forms of Vitamin C, plus antioxidant-rich kakadu plum and moisture-boosting glycerin.

items.title: Salt Water Vanilla - Sunscreen Body Oil
items.body: Sunscreen Body Oil SPF 50 PA++++ contains a nourishing blend of kukui and mongongo oils and vitamin C to leave the skin with a radiant-looking glow without the damaging effects of the sun. Formulated with an innovative gel-like texture.

items.title: Coral Coast - Serum Deodorant
items.body: Our serum deodorant is formulated with a multi-acid blend of mandelic, lactic and polyhydroxy that acidifies the skin to combat odor, brighten the look of discoloration, and smooth and reduce the look of ingrowns. Clinically proven to combat odor for 48 hours.

items.title: Coral Coast - Body Wash
items.body: Our replenishing body wash refreshes the skin with a burst of hydration. Coconut water, sunflower lipids, niacinamide, and a mineral complex leave skin feeling soft, smooth and lightly fragranced.

items.title: Salt Water Vanilla - Body Rituals Set
items.body: Discover our Salt Water Vanilla collection with three full-size essentials. Warm and enveloping, yet comforting and sweet. Salt Water Vanilla melds delectable sweetness with an edge of salt breeze. Bundle and save 15% off.

items.title: Coral Coast - Body Mist
items.body: Juicy, lush and quietly nostalgic, Coral Coast captures the feeling of endless summer. Dermatologist Tested. Cruelty-Free. Paraben-Free. Gluten-Free. Vegan.

items.title: Salt Water Vanilla - Radiance Duo
items.body: Exfoliate, nourish, and glow with the Salt Water Vanilla Radiance Duo. This two-step ritual pairs our Vitamin C Oil-Infused Body Scrub with our Nourishing Body Oil to leave skin feeling softer, smoother, and hydrated.

home.fit: **Body care, not facial skincare — and the ad set is unambiguous.** Body wash, body oil, body butter, scrubs, serum deodorant, body mist and scent collections. There is a genuine HA Body Hydrator and a Vitamin C Body Serum, so the actives language reads like skincare, but Agent 2 found 22 of 22 mined ads on body care with no facial SKU anywhere. It belongs in the beauty category and in targets.csv; it does not belong in the facial skincare hook corpus. Tagged `body_care`.
